s1Parsed.title: Midigama Beach
s1Parsed.description: Famed for its legendary peeling reef breaks including Lazy Left, Rams, and Plantations. Midigama retains an unhurried, laid-back coastal charm with authentic roadside coconut shacks, quiet stretches of sand, and golden afternoon light.

s1Parsed.title: Abimanagama Beach
s1Parsed.description: An unhurried stretch of amber sands tucked away from the main highway, ideal for restorative coastal strolls and calm water wading.

s1Parsed.title: Weligama Beach
s1Parsed.description: Sweeping 2 km crescent bay offering gentle rolling waves, vibrant surf schools, and breezy beachfront seafood grills under leaning palms.

s1Parsed.title: Ahangama Beach
s1Parsed.description: Home of the famous stilt fishing tradition, artisan sourdough bakeries, and coastal rock pools glowing in late-afternoon southern sun.

s1Parsed.title: Lazy Left Surf Break
s1Parsed.description: Long, ultra-smooth, and gentle reef wave heavily popular for longboarders and intermediate surfers peeling across deep coral.

s1Parsed.title: Rams Right Surf Break
s1Parsed.description: Fast, powerful, and sharp A-frame reef break that creates heavy hollow barrels for advanced surfers seeking technical hollow waves.

s1Parsed.title: Awee Coco Secret Pool
s1Parsed.description: Spectacular natural saltwater rock pool carved into granite, forming a calm protected ocean bathtub at low tide away from outer currents.

s1Parsed.title: Secret Jungle Beach
s1Parsed.description: Hidden, quiet rocky cove sheltered by ancient banyan trees and lush tropical foliage, offering calm crystalline waters for tranquil morning dips.

s1Parsed.title: Polhena Beach & Coral Reef
s1Parsed.description: Protected offshore calm reef lagoon celebrated across Sri Lanka as the premier sanctuary for swimming peacefully alongside wild green sea turtles.

s1Parsed.title: Secret Beach Mirissa
s1Parsed.description: Tucked-away paradise comprising three secluded rocky bays (Blue Lagoon, Shelley Beach, and Main Beach) with crystalline waters and palm shade.

s1Parsed.title: Coconut Tree Hill
s1Parsed.description: An iconic palm-crested red earth dome extending out into the Indian Ocean. Unmatched panoramic vantage point for golden hour sunsets and ocean breezes.

s1Parsed.title: Parrot Rock
s1Parsed.description: A solitary red-rock formation accessible via a natural sandbar at low tide, rewarding climbers with 360-degree views of the entire Mirissa sweep.

s1Parsed.title: Mirissa Coastal Promontory
s1Parsed.description: Vibrant, scenic headland marking the eastern edge of Mirissa's main bay, providing breezy ocean panoramas and tranquil rocky vantage points.

s2Parsed.title: Galle Dutch Fort
s2Parsed.description: Living 17th-century fortified citadel with cobblestone alleys, Dutch colonial architecture, ocean ramparts, and artisan jewellery boutiques.

s2Parsed.title: Martin Wickramasinghe Museum
s2Parsed.description: The preserved ancestral estate of Sri Lanka's greatest author, exhibiting indigenous southern artifacts, craft tools, and tropical gardens.

s2Parsed.title: Kushtarajagala Rock Relief
s2Parsed.description: An 8th-century Mahayana Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara relief carved directly into solid granite, surrounded by tranquil village temple grounds.

s2Parsed.title: Kumbalgama Potters' Village
s2Parsed.description: Steps from Noonna, skilled generational artisans shape authentic terracotta cooking vessels, water pots, and roof tiles on traditional hand wheels.

s2Parsed.title: Taprobane Island
s2Parsed.description: Sri Lanka's only private island, built in the 1920s by the eccentric Count de Mauny, rising like a romantic tropical dream in Weligama Bay.

s2Parsed.title: Koggala Lake & Mangroves
s2Parsed.description: An expansive brackish lagoon dotted with cinnamon-growing islands, ancient Buddhist hermitages, and birdwatching boat safaris under tropical foliage.

s2Parsed.title: Koggala Stilt Fishermen Coast
s2Parsed.description: The iconic Sri Lankan fishing spectacle where anglers balance delicately on wooden crossbars planted in the surf to cast for spotted herrings.

s2Parsed.title: Whale Watching Cruises
s2Parsed.description: Board eco-conscious morning boats from Mirissa Harbour to witness magnificent blue whales, fin whales, and acrobat spinner dolphins in deep ocean waters.

s2Parsed.title: Snake Farm Weligama
s2Parsed.description: A renowned family of traditional Ayurvedic doctors who rescue and protect indigenous reptiles while providing natural snakebite cures and educational talks.
